| `vendor/oxrdfxml` | crates.io `oxrdfxml` 0.1.7 (oxigraph, MIT OR Apache-2.0) | crate tarball | Ported to quick-xml 0.42 after oxigraph main's own bumps (7b37e7eb37, 822b7c9462, 348f8e0208): text and entity references gathered per element, attribute values normalized with a nesting cap of 1024, names as `&str`. Every oxrdfxml release up to 0.2.5 takes quick-xml ^0.37 (RUSTSEC-2026-0194, -0195, CVSS 7.5; upstream issue oxigraph#2006). Proven against the W3C RDF/XML suite (204 files, the same triples or both refused as the crates.io 0.1.7) and hand cases; one change: text around a CDATA section is one literal (0.1.7 refused it). Drop this copy when an oxrdfxml release takes quick-xml >= 0.41. |

Same features and dependencies otherwise. Drop this copy when a release after 0.7.0 ships. |

The root `Cargo.toml` and `crates/portal/Cargo.toml` patch the two git URLs to these paths; the root `[patch.crates-io]` takes `vendor/oxrdfxml` and `vendor/tikv-jemalloc-ctl`.
